meta.title: Lba Cra And Council Formal Meeting

votes.motion: Approve the LBA meeting minutes of May 6, 2025, May 20, 2025, June 3, 2025, and June 10, 2025
votes.description: The Local Building Authority Board approved four sets of prior meeting minutes from 2025.

votes.motion: Approve the LBA Consent Agenda (set public hearing date of May 19, 2026 for Resolution: Budget for the Capital Projects Fund of the Local Building Authority for Fiscal Year 2026-27)
votes.description: The LBA Board set May 19, 2026 as the date to accept public comment and consider adopting the FY2026-27 Capital Projects Fund budget, which covers bond debt service for the Glendale and Marmalade Libraries.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the Local Building Authority and reconvene as the Salt Lake City Community Reinvestment Agency Board
votes.description: The LBA Board formally adjourned its session and transitioned to meet as the Community Reinvestment Agency Board.

votes.motion: Approve the CRA Consent Agenda (set public hearing date of May 19, 2026 for Resolution: Budget for the Community Reinvestment Agency of Salt Lake City for Fiscal Year 2026-27)
votes.description: The CRA Board set May 19, 2026 as the date to accept public comment and consider adopting the FY2026-27 budget for the Community Reinvestment Agency of Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the Community Reinvestment Agency Board and reconvene as the Salt Lake City Council
votes.description: The CRA Board formally adjourned its session and transitioned to meet as the Salt Lake City Council.

votes.motion: Approve the Council Work Session meeting minutes of January 13, 2026, and February 3, 2026, as well as the Council retreat follow-up meeting minutes of February 3, 2026
votes.description: The City Council approved three sets of prior work session and retreat follow-up meeting minutes from early 2026.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 16 of 2026, Wilmington Avenue Partial Street Vacation at Approximately 2192 South 2000 East, not requiring the applicant to purchase the vacated property from the City
votes.description: The Council vacated approximately 775 square feet of public right-of-way on Wilmington Avenue adjacent to the property at approximately 2191 South 2000 East, incorporating it into the adjacent property owner's boundary without requiring purchase of the land.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 17 of 2026, enacting Title 9, Chapter 50 to the Salt Lake City Code, Community Clean Energy Program
votes.description: The Council established the Community Clean Energy Program, allowing nearly all Salt Lake City homes and businesses to be automatically enrolled in a renewable energy program through Rocky Mountain Power, with an opt-out option.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 8 of 2026 approving FY2026-27 funding allocations for Federal Housing and Community Development Grants and City Funding Our Future Housing Programs, including CDBG, ESG, HOME, and HOPWA grant funding, as well as 2025-2026 Funding Our Future funding distributions, and allocate $255,000 to First Step House for FOF Item 21 (Housing Case Management) in the next budget amendment
votes.description: The Council authorized grant funding allocations for federal and local housing programs for FY2026-27, adopted the Federal One-Year Annual Action Plan, and approved an Interlocal Cooperation Agreement with HUD, while directing $255,000 from FOF fund balance to First Step House.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 18 of 2026, Zoning Map Amendment at Approximately 1073 South Navajo Street
votes.description: The Council rezoned the property at approximately 1073 South Navajo Street from R-1/5,000 (Single-Family Residential) to RMF-30 (Low Density Multi-Family) to allow construction of additional for-sale homes on the 0.49 acre lot.

votes.motion: Approve the Council Consent Agenda (set public hearing dates for multiple items including FY2026-27 City Budget, Compensation for Officers, Camping Ordinance, Zoning Amendments, Street Vacations, Mountain View Corridor Conveyance, and Honorary Street Renaming)
votes.description: The Council set public hearing dates for eight upcoming items including the FY2026-27 city budget, officer compensation, a camping/public property ordinance, zoning map amendments, street vacations, a property conveyance to UDOT, and an honorary street renaming for Dolores Huerta.
